fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 10% of gross sales up to $999,999.99; 9% on sales exceeding $1M; 8% on sales exceeding $2M; 7% on sales exceeding $3M per calendar year. Technology fee presently $60/week. Brand Marketing Fund up to 1% when established. Other fees: conventions max $1,000/person, transfer fee $3,000-$9,900, various nominal fees.
